name: google-workspace
description: Integrates Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Chat, and Contacts via Google Workspace MCP servers. OAuth 2.0 Bearer token auth — one token covers all five services.

connection.instructions: Obtain a Google OAuth 2.0 access token with ALL the required Workspace scopes and paste it below. Tokens expire after ~1 hour — re-paste a fresh token when the connection stops working. See the README for step-by-step instructions on how to generate a token via the Google OAuth 2.0 Playground or your own OAuth client.

fields.name: GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN
fields.label: Google OAuth 2.0 Access Token
fields.helpText: A single Google OAuth 2.0 access token used for all five services (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Chat, Contacts). Must include all five scopes listed in the README. Tokens expire after ~1 hour — re-paste when you see 401 errors. Stored encrypted per user.
